title: Device Schema

schema_version.description: Version of the metadata schema used by this device record

device_internal_id.description: Unique internal identifier for the device

device_model.description: Model name or number of the device

device_serial_number.description: Serial number assigned to the individual device

device_calibration_date.description: Required date of the device's most recent applicable calibration (format YYYY-MM-DD).

device_firmware_version.description: Firmware version installed on the device

device_datasheet_id.description: Reference to the general device specifications. Datasheet ID (slug). Version suffix optional; e.g., lumitech-lt100-v1.0

device_sensors.description: List of sensors contained within the device

device_sensor_type.description: Type of sensor (e.g., photopic light sensor, UV sensor)

device_sensor_datasheet_id.description: Optional reference to a separate detailed datasheet for this sensor component. Omit when the required whole-device datasheet covers the integrated sensor.

$comment: Missing-value convention: Optional properties with no value must be omitted rather than represented as null, an empty string, or an empty array.
